stories.title: Share GitHub URL with Alex via kakaocli
stories.blocker: kakaocli send drives KakaoTalk via UI automation; the shell hosting Claude Code lacks 'Send Apple events to System Events' permission — kakaocli reports 'KakaoTalk launched but did not become ready within timeout'. Dry-run works (`command kakaocli send 'Alex Park' --dry-run '<URL>'` succeeds), so the chat-name match is confirmed; only the actual UI-driving send is blocked.
stories.remediation: Operator runs the bare command in a terminal that has accessibility rights, OR pastes the URL into KakaoTalk manually. Command to copy: `command kakaocli send 'Alex Park' 'Hey, here\'s the autoresearch-splice repo I just published — Korean same-source splice detection grown by an LLM agent over ~500 hypothesis/discard commits. Forked from karpathy/autoresearch and pivoted to audio. https://github.com/mutual-solutions/autoresearch-splice'`
